name: Mother NTR Training
source:
You play as James, an 18 years old highschool student with a gruesome childhood trauma, where you saw your father die in front of your eyes in a planned robbery. Since then you keep getting bullied by your friends because you look weak and vulnerable.

Your loving mother Lucy was an ex-self-defense teacher before working with your father as his secretary, but even your mom can't do anything to your bullies because beating teens will be a criminal offense.

This forced you and your mom to keep on moving to different places to find a better school for you, but unfortunately, that makes your mom unable to find work.

Luckily, your father's old friend Ron has a solution for you. You go to his private high school and be friends with his kid and he will make sure you and your mom have a warm place to live. This was the best deal for you. It's like killing two birds with one stone.

But now, your mother Lucy has to find a new job again.

What kind of job will your mom choose? What kind of people will she meet? The choice is all yours!

[Edited from [url=https://signsun66.itch.io/mother-ntr-training]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演詹姆斯，一名18岁的高中生，童年经历过可怕的创伤，你亲眼目睹你的父亲在一场有计划的抢劫中死在你的眼前。从那时起，你不断受到朋友的欺负，因为你看起来很弱小。

你慈爱的母亲露西在与你父亲一起担任秘书之前曾是一名自卫老师，但即使是你的妈妈也无法对你的欺凌者做任何事情，因为殴打青少年将构成刑事犯罪。

这迫使你和你妈妈不断搬到不同的地方，为你寻找更好的学校，但不幸的是，这让你妈妈找不到工作。

幸运的是，你父亲的老朋友罗恩为你提供了一个解决方案。你去他的私立高中，和他的孩子成为朋友，他会确保你和你妈妈有一个温暖的住所。这对你来说是最好的交易。这就像一石二鸟。

但现在，你的母亲露西必须再次找到一份新工作。

你妈妈会选择什么样的工作？她会遇到什么样的人呢？选择权都在你手中！
